description: This file provides utility functions for managing environment variable mappings between common configurations and framework-specific configurations, utilizing YAML templates to define mappings and prefixes.

methods.name: Path get_template_path(framework: str)
methods.description: Constructs the path to the environment template file for a given framework based on the current directory structure.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Dict[str,str]] parse_template_file(template_path: Path)
methods.description: Reads and parses a YAML template file to extract an optional prefix and a mapping dictionary for environment variables.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] apply_prefix_mapping(common_env: Dict[str, str], prefix: str)
methods.description: Applies a prefix to all environment variable keys within a given dictionary.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] map_common_to_framework(framework: str, common_env: Dict[str, str])
methods.description: Maps common environment variables to framework-specific ones based on the template, applying direct mappings and prefixes where applicable.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] map_framework_to_common(framework: str, framework_env: Dict[str, str])
methods.description: Maps framework-specific environment variables back to common variables, considering direct mappings and prefixes.

methods.name: list get_supported_frameworks()
methods.description: Detects and lists all frameworks supported by the presence of a template file within subdirectories.

ctags.name: apply_prefix_mapping
ctags.pattern: /^def apply_prefix_mapping(common_env: Dict[str, str], prefix: str) -> Dict[str, str]:$/

ctags.name: map_common_to_framework
ctags.pattern: /^def map_common_to_framework(framework: str, common_env: Dict[str, str]) -> Dict[str, str]:$/

ctags.name: map_framework_to_common
ctags.pattern: /^def map_framework_to_common(framework: str, framework_env: Dict[str, str]) -> Dict[str, str]:$/
